visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Constructor and toString Instead of Public Fields
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Fields are set one by one from outside the class and printed with repeated concatenation. Give the class a constructor, private final fields and a toString. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A constructor makes sure an object is never half-initialised, final fields cannot be changed by accident, and toString puts the formatting in one place instead of in every caller.
